protocol.source_selection: stable SHA256 rank among FIT sources with >=2 eligible videos
protocol.video_selection: stable SHA256 rank among eligible videos with >=6 sampled_steps
protocol.step_selection: six evenly spaced unique sampled_steps including both endpoints
protocol.folds: three fixed source pairs in stable hash order
protocol.pair_denominator: all cross-step unordered row pairs within each selected video

limitations: This is a sampling and provenance manifest, not identity accuracy or module benefit evidence.
Pair support counts are not independent video or source observations.
The FIT partition is exploratory parameter-fit data; it is not an independent test.
Per-step dump rows can share a frame; image count is reported separately from row and pair counts.
